user.title: Connect gate
user.description: Pick the relay that pulses the gate and the sensor that tells whether it is open or closed. An example rule is added after setup: weekdays 08:00-17:00, close after 15 minutes, not when someone is home.

data_description.relay_entity: The UniFi Access button, switch, lock or script that moves the gate.
data_description.sensor_entity: Your Sensative strip. By default 'on' means the gate is open.
data_description.sensor_inverted: Tick if the sensor reports 'on' when the gate is closed.
data_description.travel_time: How long the gate takes to fully open or close. No new pulse is sent within this time, otherwise the gate stops or reverses.
data_description.retries: How many times to pulse again when the gate does not reach the requested position.
data_description.presence_entities: Persons, phones or the Home zone. If anyone is home, rules with 'not when someone is home' skip closing.
data_description.notify_service: Optional, e.g. notify.mobile_app_phone. Leave empty for a Home Assistant notification only.

abort.already_configured: This sensor already belongs to a gate.

rule.title: Rule
rule.description: A rule applies within its time window on the chosen days. Windows across midnight (22:00 to 06:00) are fine. Equal start and end mean all day.

data.name: Name
data.skip_when_home: Do not close when someone is home
data.open_at_start: Open at the start of the window
data.close_at_end: Close at the end of the window

data_description.auto_close: When the gate opens within this window (app, badge or here), it closes by itself after the set time.
data_description.skip_when_home: Applies to automatic closing and to closing at the end. When the last person leaves, the timer starts again.

error.no_action: Pick at least one action: close automatically, open at start or close at end.
